wikipediaRead.title: Euphrates
wikipediaRead.supportJa: 記事はユーフラテスをトルコ・シリア・イラクを流れる西アジアの河川として説明します。2 Chronicles 9:26の無名の「川」との同定は聖書本文側の文脈推定です。

primaryWitnesses.text: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

primaryWitnesses.text: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: WEB本文は固有名「ユーフラテス」でなく「the River」とのみ記します。ソロモンの勢力範囲の文脈からユーフラテスとする解釈を候補として記録し、同定を確定しません。
ネコ王はユーフラテス川沿いのカルケミシュへ戦いに向かいます。
